method: Hypothesis-level cross-shard dedup over K+L+M: ideas compared on core_hypothesis content (mechanism + falsification design), not title strings. Two ideas are duplicates when they assert the same mechanism with the same falsification design, differing only in substrate (task, modality, metric, or the X-slot of a template). Per the w2 diversity-audit ruling, FAMILY MEMBERSHIP was treated as a MERGE TRIGGER with the fingerprint cap of <=6 kept primaries per unique fingerprint cell (manipulated-variable x measurement-family); thematic families whose members occupy distinct cells were flagged (flagged_permutation), not merged wholesale — the w3 precedent. The w2 equalization-null guard (<=3 matched-budget-null claims per shard) fired once (gen_l). Lexical Jaccard scans (within-wave, vs the 592 w3 master, vs w3-accepted G/H remand context, vs the 3 collision-only shards) found NO pair above 0.24 — duplication in this wave is family/hypothesis-level, so all verdicts rest on the judge's manual hypothesis comparison. Kept ideas were checked against the 592 accepted master ideas (and, at the finalize-time re-fetch, against the 638-line GATE-5-repair tip — see canonical_master_reference.gate5_repair_tip): near-verbatim substrate ports were killed with the master id as merge target (3 kills: K-079->A-052, K-100->C-024, K-104->C-077, on the w3 mg-precedent standard); family-adjacent ideas were kept with flags, HIGH-collision keeps routed to the novelty gate first-in-line. Collision-only shards gen_n/gen_p/gen_o were enumerated for flags only; w3-accepted G/H (GATE-5 remand lane, not yet in master) were flagged as 'w3-accepted:*' context. gen_k schema drift (separate kill_threshold, plural evidence_labels) and the three-way genre vocabulary drift were AUDITED and FLAGGED for consolidator normalization; this judge invented NO numbers, thresholds or evidence labels. High-value anomalies protected. Deliberate tensions (10 pairs, within-wave and cross-wave) recorded for adjudication-by-experiment rather than dedup. NO novelty verification performed; every prior-art remark is an unverified judge hypothesis; no citations invented. Canonical state untouched.

dg01_effective_diversity_not_count.reason: Same law: geometry-model performance is governed by effective scene/layout diversity, not raw image/frame count (correlated frames and layout-redundant images inflate nominal counts). K-054 states the compute-matched scaling form (unique-scene count vs frames-per-scene vs parameters); K-014's layout-stratified-subset replication of full-data depth performance is the subset-selection arm of the same falsification. Cell cap fired (effective-diversity cell); K-014's layout-coverage-saturation arm preserved. Both collide with gen_n scaling territory (N-027/N-014) — flagged.

dg02_densification_capacity_null.reason: Same null hypothesis with two replacement arms: the celebrated adaptive densify-split-prune machinery of Gaussian splatting is not the active ingredient — K-037 claims a blind capacity schedule (annealing) matches it, K-043 claims overcomplete-init-then-prune (capacity-then-selection) matches it. One matched-budget falsification decides both; same subject_system and measurement_family (matched-budget NVS quality). K-043 kept as the grow-vs-prune arm.

dg03_frame_subset_information_locality.reason: One information-locality measurement, two arms: K-070's oracle frame-subset audit (benchmarks answerable from <1% of frames => they measure retrieval) is the oracle arm of K-067's learned query-conditioned selector claim (10% budget retains nearly all accuracy). Same benchmarks, same sufficiency-vs-budget instrument; the oracle audit is the selector study's mandatory baseline. K-070's benchmark-critique deliverable preserved as an arm.

dg04_interface_ceiling_and_recovery.reason: One falsification unit: L-011 measures the text-interface information ceiling (probe on textual intermediates plateaus below probe on raw tool outputs); L-015 recovers it with a soft-token adapter, isolating discretization as the binding constraint. Measuring the recovery fraction (L-015) requires measuring the gap (L-011) as its control arm. Same mechanism (verbalization discards spatial detail), same probe instrument. HIGH master adjacency E-041 flagged.

dg05_shared_percept_sampling_regime.reason: L-021's saturation curve (self-consistency voting flattens by k=4 on perception-bound questions because samples share the same wrong percept) is the direct corollary measurement of L-030's regime law (cross-sample variance under cheap sampling detects compute-limited vs representation-limited instances and predicts loop-gain sign). Family-cap trigger (shared_percept_decorrelation): merging L-021 keeps the family's kept cells at the cap. Saturation-curve arm preserved.

dg06_measured_competence_conditioning.reason: Same intervention and claim, X-slot swap: inject empirically measured per-tool reliability profiles into the controller/planner prompt and decision quality beats description/signature conditioning. L-009 = router instance (competence cards vs descriptions), L-047 = program-synthesis instance (error profiles vs signatures). One probe-suite-then-condition design; L-047's plan-structure-shift predictions preserved as an arm.

dg07_guideline_interpretation_noise.reason: One mechanism (guideline interpretation is the dominant label-noise source in agent annotation), audit arm + fix arm: L-054 shows paraphrasing guidelines shifts label distributions as much as swapping the model; L-059 removes the interpretation step by compiling guidelines into executable checklists and claims the variance reduction beats a model upgrade. Same boundary-case locus, same noise-attribution design. L-054's publish-and-version-guidelines reproducibility arm preserved.

dg08_pipeline_variance_decomposition.reason: Near-verbatim within-shard duplicate: both run the same nested/single-source seed-toggling variance-attribution design on vision-agent pipelines and both conclude controller token-sampling dominates end-answer variance, with the same freeze-the-top-component deliverable. L-069 is the active-viewing instance (adds a crop-selection component) of L-097's general pipeline law; crop-selection component preserved as an arm.

dg09_iso_compute_equalization_null.reason: w2 equalization-null guard (<=3 per shard) fired: gen_l carries four matched-budget-null ideas (L-002, L-061, L-074, L-092). L-074 (majority voting matches debate/arbitration at iso-compute; deliberation is compute repackaged) is the protocol-comparison arm of L-092's iso-cost accounting protocol (loop vs bigger single model; a large share of loop gains is purchased compute). Same normalization design, same shrinkage measurement. L-074's protocol-spread arm preserved; tension with kept L-071 (mixed-encoder debate gains) recorded.

dg10_depth_target_gradient_allocation.reason: Same cell (monocular depth regression targets x AbsRel/delta1 + gradient statistics): the target parameterization (metric/log/inverse) acts as a per-pixel gradient preconditioner, not a representational change. M-001 states the law (log wins exactly on wide depth-range scenes, with a predictable threshold); M-002 is the equivalence control (explicit 1/z^2 Jacobian rescaling reproduces the inverse-depth advantage without changing target space). One falsification: manipulate parameterization and matched gradient rescaling, decompose. Constructive recipe arm preserved.

dg11_budget_crossover_reweighting.reason: Same law, spatial vs spectral statement: default gradient allocation starves boundary/high-frequency structure until interiors saturate, so emphasis reweighting (boundary emphasis in M-015, wavelet/Fourier band boosting in M-010) only helps under truncated budgets, with a measurable crossover budget where the benefit vanishes. Boundary bands ARE the high-frequency content; both designs sweep reweighting x budget and read band/region-resolved error vs budget. Cell cap fired; M-010's frequency-basis instrument preserved as an arm.

dg12_conflict_localized_decoder_splittin.reason: Same instrument and claim, population-slot swap: measure layer-resolved gradient-conflict profiles between two demand populations sharing decoder features, then place the architectural split at the measured conflict onset and capture the full-split benefit at a fraction of parameters. M-061 = intra-task populations (boundary vs interior pixels), M-062 = inter-task (segmentation vs depth). Identical measurement family (conflict profiles + split-recovery fraction). M-061 kept primary for the fresher intra-task claim; M-062's multi-task folklore-replacement arm preserved.

dg13_confusable_pair_zero_sum.reason: M-066's observed law (confusable class pairs show anti-correlated late-phase accuracy fluctuations because shared evidence makes boundary updates zero-sum) is exactly the signature M-009 predicts and causally manipulates via output coupling (softmax couples logits zero-sum; sigmoid decouples). Same measurement family (pairwise fluctuation anti-correlation + boundary confusion); M-009 holds the causal arm, M-066's redistribution-vs-undertraining diagnostic preserved. Cell cap fired.

dg14_weight_averaging_boundary_failure.reason: Same mechanism and verdict on two instances of iterate averaging: weight-space averaging equals LR decay only where the local loss is quadratic/affine-compatible, and dense boundary directions violate that, so averaging matches decayed schedules on interiors but fails on boundary placement. M-039 = constant-LR+EMA (schedule-free) instance; M-100 = SWA tail-averaging instance with the boundary-disagreement adoption criterion. One region-decomposed parity design; M-100's disagreement-decomposition criterion preserved as the adoption-rule arm. Cell cap fired. Tension with kept M-035 (prediction-space snapshot averaging HELPS boundaries) recorded.

anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-027: learned flow computes texture displacement, not motion: isoluminant/second-order stimuli that humans perceive expose a missing motion-energy computation — a biological-vision-grounded capability gap
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-042: splat failures on mirrors are optimization pathologies, not representational limits: reflection-consistent initialization reaches virtual-image geometry that renders correctly
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-045: floater artifacts are fossilized exposure/white-balance inconsistency, not sparse-view ambiguity — capture photometric consistency, not more views, removes them
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-050: pointmap reconstructors output prior-consistent scale on miniatures/sets/macro — memorized scene scale masquerading as inferred geometry, with predictable error direction
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-058: rolling-shutter skew and exposure blur are absolute-time-stamped measurements of image motion — a metric-scale side channel needing no IMU or intrinsics
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-071: video foundation models near chance on arrow-of-time for physics-driven footage while passing semantic-cue clips — decisive for world-model claims and invisible to mainstream benchmarks
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-078: pixel-space next-frame loss is dominated by texture advection; dynamics-decisive pixels contribute vanishing gradient share — quantitatively predicting why low-loss predictors fail physics probes
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-085: near-forward camera motion makes object motion along the camera axis nearly indistinguishable from wrong-depth static geometry — a degeneracy affecting a large share of driving/walking footage, silently resolved by priors
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-089: rolling-shutter row time makes every frame a temporal scan: modeling it super-resolves 3D trajectories beyond the nominal frame rate — an artifact converted into a measurement channel
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-091: defocus gradients across the frame over-constrain focal length given a depth estimate — a physics-based single-image intrinsics oracle for structure-free scenes
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-K-092: scenes are saturated with gravity witnesses; visual gravity estimation can reach IMU-competitive accuracy on ordinary footage, unlocking orientation-aware vision without inertial hardware
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-L-017: persistent numbered visual IDs stamped at first detection eliminate cross-turn referring drift without model changes — identity decay located in the text channel, not the VLM
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-L-035: verify-revise dynamics form attractor maps: a measurable fraction of instances converge to stable wrong answers from any start, and convergence speed carries no information about correctness
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-L-039: blinding the verifier to the proposer's chain-of-thought RAISES perception-error detection — transcript exposure induces percept inheritance, reversing the more-context-is-better default
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-L-064: a drafted answer in the transcript acts as an anchor that survives contradicting crop evidence; zoom-first ordering removes the anchor at identical compute
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-L-076: hallucinated details become sticky after ~2 transcript repetitions (adoption probability crosses correction probability) — a quantified contagion threshold for multi-agent error lock-in
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-L-082: the generator-verifier gap that powers code/math self-improvement is structurally missing for perception: judging needs the same percept as producing — bounding all same-model visual self-training
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-L-095: failure-conditioned retries are measurably LESS grounded than first attempts on matched inputs — 'try harder' converts correct abstentions into confident confabulation
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-029: when per-pixel-mean loss gradients approach Adam's epsilon, effective steps shrink nonuniformly — resolution-dependent silent undertraining with a one-line epsilon/reduction fix
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-046: dense fine-tuning exits the linearly-connected basin of its initialization within hundreds of steps while classification stays connected — a sharp geometric signature of dense adaptation
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-054: grokking-like delayed generalization exists in dense prediction: validation boundary quality jumps long after training loss saturates, with the delay controlled by weight decay
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-074: fp16 underflow is class-selective: rare classes' sparse small-magnitude gradients fall below representable magnitude first — a precision tax invisible in mIoU
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-083: within-epoch presentation order leaves a recency imprint at high LR: statistically identical images seen late in the final epoch are predicted better — an uncontrolled ordering bias
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-085: within-image negatives make dense contrastive objectives satisfiable by position-encoding rather than content — a positional shortcut detectable by a position-decoding probe
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-095: loss spikes replicate across seeds on the same image-crop-augmentation conjunctions — spike-trigger mining is a dataset diagnostic, not a stability mystery
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-M-097: attention-entropy collapse in an identifiable set of heads precedes divergence by hundreds of steps, and clamping only those heads' temperature prevents the explosion — early warning plus causal intervention
